findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_legal_links" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Operator details and links to the terms, privacy and cookie policy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_employer_info · Private data: get_contact_and_support · Public sink: get_employer_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_employer_info · Private data: get_contact_and_support · Public sink: get_employer_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
